title: Original custom error constructors and genuine aggregate composition
oracle: Actual original CustomError/AggregateError/TimeoutError/UnimplementedMethod classes constructed with realm Reflect.construct, projected through inherited Error.toString. Original exact Babel supplies native-super wrapper/inheritance; no class is plain-called. Literal source name/default/nullish/explicit-message rules and independent Error.toString string coercion expectations. Retained genuine earlier constructed errors compose into real ordered/duplicate/nested aggregates, including failure/retry. No formatter, error record, callback, property accessor or host object substitutes for actual classes.
